items.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: The transcript shows Monk Rowe is the interviewer and Charlie Gabriel is the interviewee. They are meeting for the first time for this interview. No prior personal or professional relationship is described.

ctx.x: Charlie was interviewed in New Orleans, Louisiana on January 9, 2020 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
I’m very happy to have Charlie Gabriel with me today. My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Thanks for your time.
Oh thank you for having me. I really appreciate it.
